Fleetwood Mac performs their iconic hit Rhiannon during this pivotal 1975 concert appearance. This performance captures the band shortly after Stevie Nicks and Lindsey Buckingham joined the lineup, marking the beginning of their most commercially successful era. The track serves as a centerpiece of their self-titled album, which eventually reached number one on the Billboard 200 chart.
